description: Source code implementing the SensorsHalAidl class for Android sensors HAL, including methods for sensor activation, batching, flushing, initialization, and data injection.

classes.name: SensorsHalAidl
classes.description: Implementation of the sensors hardware abstraction layer for Android using AIDL, managing sensor activation, batching, data injection, and communication with sensor hardware.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor based on the handle.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Sets the batch parameters for a sensor.

methods.name: configDirectReport
methods.description: Configures direct report for a sensor (unsupported in this implementation).

methods.name: getSensorsList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor HAL, sets up message queues, and starts event reading thread.

methods.name: injectSensorData
methods.description: Injects sensor event data into the system.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the operation mode for all sensors.
